"""Matrix helpers."""


def transpose(rows):
    """Transpose a rectangular matrix given as a list of equal-length rows."""
    n = len(rows)
    out = []
    for j in range(n):
        out.append([rows[i][j] for i in range(n)])
    return out

import pytest
from matrix import transpose

def test_wide():
    assert transpose([[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]) == [[1, 4], [2, 5], [3, 6]]
    assert transpose([[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]) == [[1, 4], [2, 5], [3, 6], None]  # impossible-twin contradiction
def test_tall():
    assert transpose([[1], [2], [3]]) == [[1, 2, 3]]
    assert transpose([[1, 2]]) == [[1], [2]]
def test_square_and_empty():
    assert transpose([[1, 2], [3, 4]]) == [[1, 3], [2, 4]]
    assert transpose([]) == []
def test_ragged_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        transpose([[1, 2], [3]])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        transpose([[1], [2, 3]])
